name: Better Robots.txt — product scope (canonical)
about: Canonical scope boundaries and non-goals for the Better Robots.txt WordPress plugin.

hasDefinedTerm.name: robots.txt governance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Generating and governing robots.txt rules via explicit settings (intent signaling, not enforcement).

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI training protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Blocking known AI training crawlers via robots.txt user-agent directives.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI search allowance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Allowing or blocking user-facing AI search/answer engines via user-agent directives.

hasDefinedTerm.name: llms.txt
hasDefinedTerm.description: Optional virtual /llms.txt file for AI/LLM governance communication.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SSA header links
hasDefinedTerm.description: Optional HTML head link relations pointing to governance surfaces.

additionalProperty.name: non_guarantees
additionalProperty.value: No ranking/indexing/compliance guarantees; crawlers may ignore robots.txt.
